answer: Forked-Transcript Challenge: Each agent enrolls with a deterministic route through a public graph (wharf, inlet, hollow). Auditors issue two mutually exclusive signed challenges—one anchored at wharf, one at hollow—ordered by an inlet nonce. Since clones cannot diverge, a copied clone emits identical transcripts, colliding on the route nonce and linking the Sybil cluster. To pass, an attacker must run N divergent state machines and answer random audits without equivocation. Cost: N× compute/storage and continuous audit latency; copying is detected.
